authority: Reviewed E3 scientific design plus the current explicit request to propose complete finite T00b implementation/pilot values. All newly specified values are review candidates, not measured evidence or final head selections.
stage_authorization: No implementation, target acceptance, bulk cache, pilot, final training or test access is authorized

extraction.encoder_calls: E1: global only. E2: global first then one batch-major call of all four locals; no crop chunking

publication.lock: exclusive creation of .writer.lock; existing lock blocks; stale-lock removal requires operator review
publication.temporary_files: same-directory .tmp.<attempt_id> files; never consumed as completed data
publication.commit: write payload, flush/fsync, os.replace; write chunk-commit JSON only after complete payload hash/shape/index checks; fsync directory where supported and record platform capability
publication.completion: complete index.json is atomically published only after every committed chunk and rows.jsonl validates; no partial accepted index

recovery.resume: Verify immutable source/input/runtime/policy bindings, all existing chunk-commit records and payload hashes/values/row indices before reuse; discard uncommitted temporary chunks; restart only uncommitted chunk from its first row

logits.comparison: abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), every finite logit

nll.comparison: abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), per-sample CE when available and full-split sample-mean NLL

replay.reference_logits_unavailable: Compare direct source.forward against original_head(extracted feature) under accepted runtime and compare complete discrete output/derived metrics/NLL with selected-source analysis; if authoritative NLL or selected outputs unavailable, block acceptance, not comparison waiver
replay.failure: Stop for source/runtime review; no widening of tolerances, baseline replacement, source reselection or changed prediction acceptance

rng.derivation: SHA-256 of UTF-8 pipe-separated str(parts); first 8 digest bytes little-endian modulo 9223372036854775807
rng.cross_family_sampling: For matching root/source seed/stage/window, both families see identical natural permutations or cRT class/image draws. Initialization includes family because feature shapes differ.
rng.generators: Independent CPU torch.Generator per named stream; do not borrow global RNG
rng.natural: At each window initialize its stream then torch.randperm(34997,generator=natural_generator,device='cpu'); visit in permutation order, no replacement
rng.crt: At each draw call torch.randint(124,(1,),generator=class_generator,device='cpu') once, then torch.randint(n_c,(1,),generator=image_generator,device='cpu') once; map image index into immutable manifest-ordered class index. Do not vectorize, force quotas or reject repeats.
resume_state_fields: natural permutation and cursor or both cRT generator byte states
rng.resume_validation: Verify all identities and cursor bounds; completed windows committed once; uncommitted work rolls back to preceding window checkpoint

initializer.rule: Use isolated CPU torch default generator seeded by rng.initialization_parts. Construct nn.Linear(d,124,bias=True) using Torch 2.8.0 default reset: kaiming_uniform_(weight,a=sqrt(5)), then uniform_(bias,-1/sqrt(d),+1/sqrt(d)); restore outer CPU RNG. No source classifier/optimizer state.
initializer.pairing: Construct once per (stage,root_seed,family,source_seed), hash and clone exact CPU tensors for N/cRT and all LR candidates; transfer clones without changing values
initializer.actual_tensor_hashes: future observations, never precomputed from declarations

optimizer.parameters: Exactly new Linear weight and bias, once each; fresh state for every run

schedule.name: explicit_linear_warmup_then_cosine
schedule.index: u is zero-based optimizer update before it is applied, u=0..1379
schedule.step_order: Set LR for current u, zero_grad(set_to_none=True), forward/backward, finite/clipping check, optimizer.step, increment in-memory update counter; only a complete window checkpoint commits scientific progress. Next LR uses updated u. No schedule step after total budget.

budget.partial_group_loss: sum CE / actual presented rows, including the final 181-row batch
budget.crt: 34997 class-then-image draws with replacement each window

pilot.seed_decision: New explicit E3 pilot candidate choice, not an automatic adoption of E1/E2 tuning. Pilot is nonfinal; official final root IDs remain 2001/3001/4001.
pilot.source_choice: Predeclare seed 2001 for both families without ranking source seeds by metrics; no source-seed search
pilot.cache_scope: The accepted train+val bundle for E1/2001 and E2/2001; all six bulk source-cache bundles still require CACHE-ACCEPT under the unchanged gate sequence

common_protocol_selection.completion: Both candidate protocols must complete all four full-budget trials within caps, with complete histories and no nonfinite/skipped data/updates; otherwise stop, no automatic winner among survivors

adequacy_per_arm.criterion: All checks must pass for all four arms of a protocol. These are bounded optimization-stability diagnostics, not proof of convergence, statistical significance or a minimum gain over original/N/cRT.

common_protocol_selection.eligible_protocol: A completed common protocol satisfying all four arms' adequacy checks
common_protocol_selection.score: Arithmetic mean of the four arms' selected-head supported validation Macro-F1 values, equal weight 1/4, using unrounded values; diagnostic pilot selection only
common_protocol_selection.tie_scope: global maximum-anchored: eligible if global_max_score-score <= tolerance
common_protocol_selection.tie_break: Choose lower base_lr among tied eligible protocols; candidate_id lexical order if needed
common_protocol_selection.no_eligible_protocol: STOP for review; no extra trials, horizon extension or winner
common_protocol_selection.report: All protocols, four-arm histories, adequacy checks, scores, attempts/failures and tradeoffs; one winner proposal only after authorized pilot

winner.reason: The pilot has not run; no winner selected

runtime.actual_environment_identity: Observe and bind at TARGET-AUTH/G2; no target acceptance exists now

head_recovery.head_commit_unit: one completed training window plus its complete validation/selection/history
save_fields: optimizer/scheduler state and inactive scaler policy
head_recovery.resume: Restore same immutable last; discard and replay the entire uncommitted window including sampling/optimizer/scheduler/validation; source/cache bytes cannot change
head_recovery.completed_budget: Publication-only recovery; no more training/validation selection points
head_recovery.attempt_policy: At most two attempts per logical pilot run (initial plus one same-identity retry), charged to operational caps; no new candidate or scientific updates credited by replay
head_recovery.partial_failure_charge: Record exact observed partial work when known; otherwise conservatively charge the whole uncommitted window's 34997 presentations, 69 updates and one validation pass before replay
head_recovery.atomic_publication: Same-directory write+flush/fsync+os.replace; one writer and immutable run lock; no hidden rollback of committed history
head_recovery.future_protocol_change: Requires review; not automatic retry with changed batch/LR/dtype/budget

planned_output_roots.root_resolution: All destinations are explicit caller-supplied project-relative roots beneath the execution workspace, resolved with containment/symlink checks; these are planned destinations, not existing inputs
planned_output_roots.run_layout: {pilot_or_final}/{run_id}/; run_id assigned only after full immutable declaration bindings exist

bounded_acceptance.operations: For each of the 12 source/member pairs: direct forward, frozen extraction+original-head replay, and bounded extraction interruption/recovery; at most four original-image presentations per pair. Record E2's five views separately.

head_fixtures.features: Private deterministic synthetic full-dimension tensors or explicitly repeated train-only fixture features; exercise full batch 512 and tail 181; never publish as cache/pilot/final results

bounded_acceptance.source_missing: Source loading/extraction fixtures blocked until actual binaries and applicable identities materialized and verified; no fake checkpoint substitution
bounded_acceptance.g2_readiness_requires: All six source lineages and actual source/extraction/runtime/recovery evidence; source checksum references alone cannot pass

required_final_protocol: Only a later HEAD-FREEZE-approved winner from this finite pilot may populate a fully resolved common official profile, and FINAL-AUTH is separate

future_generated_values.reason: Observations require authorized implementation/execution or explicit user approval

authorization_binding_policy.scientific_declarations: Cache/acceptance/pilot/final declarations contain consumed scientific inputs and required gate ID, but not the receipt hash for that same operation.
authorization_binding_policy.approval: The corresponding receipt may bind exact scientific declaration bytes/hashes and required earlier inputs/evidence.
authorization_binding_policy.execution: Only a separate e3_stage_execution_request_v1 joins a complete declaration payload hash with an already-approved receipt hash. That wrapper is not a subject of the same receipt.
authorization_binding_policy.pre_target_request: Source inputs and requested runtime/data/allocation/code identities only; it must not require source_acceptance_sha256 or accepted_runtime_sha256 produced by that target run.
authorization_binding_policy.post_target: Bulk-cache/head source and runtime bindings require actual verified acceptance evidence and applicable G2 receipt.
authorization_binding_policy.cache_replay_no_self_hash_cycle: Replay evidence binds source, ordered row index and complete payload identity, not the hash of index.json that embeds replay evidence. Validate full build payloads before publishing final complete index; no partial cache is a training input.
